workday:paypal:/job/Bangalore-Karnataka-.text:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:What you need to know about the role- 
As an iOS Software Engineer, you will build and maintain the PayPal POS app that small businesses use every day to take payments, run checkout and manage their shop. You will work on features across the app experience, from first sign-in and bootstrap to checkout, receipts, refunds and invoices, and learn how it connects to card readers and Tap to Pay on iPhone. 

 
Meet our team 
Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned.

Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities: 
Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
May contribute to code & design reviews

Minimum Qualifications:
1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
Your way to impact
Make checkout and receipts fast and reliable for merchants who depend on the app at the counter.
Deliver features across product library, inventory, purchase history, refunds and invoices.
Help legacy Zettle merchants move onto PayPal identity with a smooth sign-in and onboarding experience in the app.
Improve app stability, release quality and crash-free sessions.

Your day to day
Build and ship features in Swift using modern concurrency; UIKit and SwiftUI as the product requires.
Integrate with backend services over REST and GraphQL; handle auth and session flows.
Work with Bluetooth reader connectivity (Core Bluetooth) and Apple payment frameworks under guidance.
Write unit and UI tests, and take part in code reviews, CI/CD and staged releases.
Investigate crashes and production issues using analytics and monitoring and fix root causes.
Pair with Sweden engineers and write documentation and runbooks for areas you take over.

What do you need to bring-
1 to 3 years of iOS development experience with strong Swift.
Hands-on with SwiftUI and/or UIKit, networking, local persistence and concurrency.
Experience with unit and UI testing and CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps.
Understanding of secure handling of sensitive data on device.
Interest in payments; experience with in-app payments, Bluetooth peripherals or NFC is a plus.
Nice to have: Objective-C, GraphQL clients, Apple Tap to Pay on iPhone.
Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden.
A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records.
Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product.

**We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don't hesitate to apply.

Subsidiary:PayPal

Travel Percent:0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes.  Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately.  To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us. 

For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

Our Benefits:
At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.

Click Here to learn more about our culture and community.

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.  In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.  If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.

Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.

ashby:harvey:6c87b165-99ad-484e-b34b-1cf.title: Research Engineer / Scientist, Data & Evals
ashby:harvey:6c87b165-99ad-484e-b34b-1cf.text:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals in Harvey Research, you’ll build the data and measurement systems that power our post-training, benchmarking, and agent capability efforts.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own synthetic data pipelines, evaluation design, the tasks and grading behind training environments, and the systems that turn feedback from domain experts into training signals and rewards. These are tasks where correctness often can’t be verified automatically, so defining and measuring quality is a core research challenge. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers who can build reliable data and evaluation systems, question what a metric actually tells us, and work closely with researchers and legal experts to turn model failures into measurable improvements.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research http://harvey.ai/research.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build synthetic data pipelines that generate, filter, and curate training and evaluation samples for complex legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

 - Design evaluations and verifiers that reflect real legal work, calibrate them against expert judgment, and investigate where they fail.

 - Build and maintain capability benchmarks like our Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), along with product-focused evals that track how models perform on real customer workflows.

 - Work with legal domain experts to define quality metrics, rubrics, and other grading mechanisms for training and evaluation.

 - Own training and evaluation data quality, including provenance, coverage, and safeguards against contamination.

 - Close the loop from product usage and customer feedback to new evaluations and training data, so models improve where customers need them most.

 - Partner with researchers to investigate model failures, distinguish real gains from misleading metrics, and use findings to guide training and release decisions.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Experience building data pipelines, ML evaluation systems, or experimentation tooling, with strong Python skills and ownership of production-quality code.

 - A rigorous approach to measurement, including statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding when a metric can mislead.

 - The ability to translate ambiguous goals or expert judgment into structured datasets, rubrics, and measurable criteria.

 - Experience with synthetic data, LLM evaluations, automated raters, or preference data is a plus. Strong data and measurement engineering experience close to ML model development is valuable even without prior LLM work.

We are hiring for this role across multiple levels.




COMPENSATION

$230,000 - $450,000 USD

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Member of Technical Staff, Infrastructure in Harvey Research, you’ll build the systems that power how we adapt and improve leading open-weight models for legal work.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own the infrastructure behind that effort: distributed training, RL rollout systems, the environments where models learn to use tools and complete complex legal workflows, and the internal systems the team uses to manage data, run evals, and launch and track training jobs. You’ll help decide what we build, what we adopt, and how the pieces fit together. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the stack.

We’re looking for research engineers who have built demanding ML or distributed systems, can debug across the stack, and want to work closely with researchers to make training faster, more reliable, and easier to iterate on.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research http://harvey.ai/research.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Scale our post-training stack, supporting SFT and RL on leading open-weight models.

 - Build distributed rollout infrastructure that coordinates model inference, tool execution, and collection of training experience for long-horizon tasks.

 - Build the infrastructure for reproducible agent environments where models can interact with documents, tools, and external systems during training and evaluation.

 - Own the performance and reliability of training runs, including GPU utilization, checkpointing, failure recovery, and observability.

 - Identify and remove bottlenecks across training and inference to shorten the path from research idea to useful result.

 - Build the internal tools and services the team runs on: training data management and versioning, running evals and browsing results, and launching and tracking training jobs and experiments.

 - Integrate models into production, including serving, latency, cost, and online evaluation, so research reaches customers quickly and safely.

 - Partner closely with researchers to turn experimental workflows into dependable systems while keeping room for rapid experimentation.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Experience building ML infrastructure, distributed systems, or research tooling, with ownership of performance, reliability, and operation.

 - Strong Python and generalist software engineering skills across backend services, data systems, and internal tools, with familiarity with PyTorch, JAX, or similar ML frameworks.

 - Experience with distributed training or inference, including diagnosing performance bottlenecks and failures across the stack.

 - Understanding of post-training workflows; experience with RL rollouts, agent environments, or sandboxed tool execution is a plus.

 - Practical judgment about what to build versus adopt, and the ability to partner with researchers and ship quickly as needs evolve.

We are hiring for this role across multiple levels.




COMPENSATION

$230,000 - $450,000 USD

You’ll own the post-training recipe across SFT and RL, including reward design and verification for challenging, semi-verifiable legal tasks.  - Develop reward functions and verifiers for semi-verifiable tasks, including rubrics, learned preference models, and expert preference data, and study where they break.

 - Run and debug training at scale, addressing divergence, reward hacking, and instability.

 - Build and use rigorous evals to track improvements and decide what ships.

 - Design, implement, test, and debug code across our research stack.

 - Hands-on experience post-training LLMs with SFT and RL, including preference optimization, and direct ownership of training runs and results.

 - Deep ML fundamentals and experience getting distributed training runs working reliably.

 - Strong engineering skills in Python, with production-quality code and end-to-end system ownership.

 - Research experience in RL for language models or reward modeling, with the ability to move quickly from experiments to shipped improvements. Publications welcome, not required.
